policy.required_outcome: source-local boundary attachment with validation and rollback

assurance_scope_metadata.description: Assurance standards, conclusions, signatories, locations and incorporated references whose meaning depends on the engagement scope.
rejected_shortcuts: treat issuer-hosted auditor text as issuer self-disclosure
assume a named standard applies to every report section
infer assurance coverage from signatory or location alone

metric_component_boundary.description: A scalar whose meaning depends on a category, energy source, emissions category or control-method component.
allowed_evidence_patterns: continued table header with deterministic column coordinates
rejected_shortcuts: bind a nearby scalar without row and column coordinates
treat a component as a total
drop financial-control, operational-control or market-method qualifiers

taxonomy_classification_boundary.description: EU Taxonomy values requiring denominator, eligibility, alignment, materiality and activity-class separation.
allowed_evidence_patterns: taxonomy accounting-policy definition and audit-status check
rejected_shortcuts: use a total as an eligible amount
promote a value explicitly marked unaudited

organizational_population_boundary.description: Headcount or workforce values whose inclusion depends on entity coverage, acquisition status or HR-system coverage.
allowed_evidence_patterns: explicit included and excluded population statement
reconciliation between global total and covered subset
rejected_shortcuts: treat an excluded-population difference as a global total
assume HR-system coverage equals consolidation scope

target_and_performance_boundary.description: Targets and reductions requiring target year, baseline year, scopes, value-chain coverage and comparison relation.
allowed_evidence_patterns: single target clause binding percentage, target year and baseline
deterministic comparison formula tied to disclosed values
rejected_shortcuts: select one of several years by proximity
treat issuer-stated rounded change as deterministic recomputation
